Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. The vehicles provided by the Contractor on hire will be with Driver and the vehicles provide d must be in excellent condition, clean, mechanically fit and should be in white/gr ey/silvercolor only. 2. The vehicles should fulfill the legal obligations prescribed by the State Transport Authority li ke payment of road taxes etc., and all requirements under various statutory Laws must be c omplied with. Any default will be the liability of the contractor and this Department shall not be liable in any manner whatsoever. 3. The vehicle shall be at the disposal of the Income tax department, Dindigul on 24x7 basis f or the entire duration of the contract period. The Duty point is the Income-tax Office, Palani Bye pass Road, Dindigul or any other place to be intimated from time to time and the mileag

e and time would be reckoned to the duty point only. In short ‘shed mileages’ will not be per mitted. 4. The vehicle operator/ Service provider shall during the period of this contract, that is to say from 01.01.2027 to 31.12.2027 or until this contract is terminated by such notice as is herei n after mentioned, will provide vehicles length of minimum 3990 mm or more and model of 2 024 to 2026(Ex. Maruti Suzuki – Dzire, Fronx, Brezza; Honda – City, Amaze and etc) for the maximum rent per month Rs.35000/- for CNG Vehicles and Rs.40,000/- for petrol and diesel vehicles (Exclusive of Taxes).The driver should be available on call of the Officer /Official usin g the vehicle for 24 x 7 days. 5. The vehicle operator should provide the particular model or make of vehicle as agreed upo n in the contract. The Department only reserves the right to substitute it with another simila r vehicle. 6.The bidder should have a Head Office located in Dindigul district of Tamil Nadu. Preferably th e bidder shall also have a fully functional Branch Office situated within 5 km radius from Income Tax Office, Dindigul for smooth day-to-day administrative coordination, emergency deployment of vehicles, submission of documents, handling complaints, replacement arrange ments, and other operational requirements. The bidder shall submit the following documentary proof of the branch office along with bid: · Valid ownership / rental / lease document of office premises. · Latest EB bill / Property Tax receipt / Trade License · GST Registration showing the same address. · Photograph of office premises with signboard. · Contact details of responsible office representative. Note: Mere production of temporary agreements, unverified rental documents, or paper ad dresses without actual functioning office shall not be accepted. The department reserves the right to conduct physical verification / inspection of the offi ce premises at any stage of tender process or contract period. If the office is found non-fun ctional non-existent, the bid shall be rejected or contract will be terminated. 7.The vehicles deputed for duty must have tank filled with fuel to cover the entire trip. This Co ntractor and the Driver shall be bound to carry out the instruction of the concerned officer(s)-in charge from time to time. 8.Insurance of the vehicles and the risk of the passengers travelling in the vehicles should be c overed by the contractor to the extent of liability as specified under the Motors Vehicles Acts & Rules and any other law in force. It is also the contractor's absolute responsibility to take care of any damages/repair caused to his vehicle during the operation of the contract. 9. The vehicle will be run by the Department for 2000 kilometers per month. The unutilized kilo meters will be carried forward to the next month and this will be continued till the end of the co

ntract period of one year or the extended period beyond one year, as the case may be. The mil eage from the vehicle provider’s office or any other place to the office premises of the entitled office will not be counted under the mileage of 2000 Kilometers per month. 10. In case no replacement is provided on ti me, this office would have a right to hire vehicles from the market and the additional cost incur red by this will be borne by the contractor & the additional cost incurred by the Department wil l be borne/ reimbursed by the Contractor or deducted from his monthly bill. 12. In case of any accident resulting in any loss or damage to property or life, the sole responsi bility for any legal or financial implication would vest with the vehicle operator. The departmen t shall have no liability whatsoever. 13. The vehicle can be called for reporting at any time. The Vehicles would remain at the dispo sal of the Department for all seven days in a week during the entire contract period. The vehicl e should not be used by the contractor or driver for any other organization or individual either during day or night during the entire contract period. 14. The driver deployed along with vehicle should satisfy the following Conditions: a. Driver should have valid Driving License with minimum 3 year experience in drivi ng. b. Driver should be well versed with the roads and different localities of respective pl aces in Trichy/Dindigul/Madurai/Chennai and surroundings. c. Driver should be provided with Mobile phone and should be available 24*7. Any c hange in the mobile number should be intimated immediately. d. Driver should wear the uniform (white pant & white shirt) as well as Identity Card while on Duty. e. Driver should be decent and well behaved. The driver should not have criminal an tecedents and it shall be responsibility of the contractor to verify his background b efore deployment and to get the police verification conducted. The conduct of the driver will be sole responsibility of the contractor and in this regard department sh all not be responsible in any manner, whatsoever. f. s well as of the officers to whom the vehicles are assigned. 17. The designation plate should be covered when the conce rned officer is not occupying the vehicle. 19. The vehicle should always be maintained in good condition. Towels, Air fresheners and se at cover which present the vehicle in good looking and running condition shall be arranged by the service provider. The Department retains the right to furnish the same and deduct s uch expenses, if required. 20. All expenses relating to toll fee shall be borne by the Contractor. 21. The Department shall not make any payment other than agreed Hire charges. No increase in hire charges shall be considered during the period of contract for any reason. 22. A Log Book/Trip Sheet Specifying daily reporting and relieving time as well as daily openin g, closing meter reading and other details as may be specified by the Department shall be maintained for the vehicle. The Contractor should submit the duly filled Log Book/trip Sheet Signed by the Controlling Officer to whom the vehicle has been assigned along with the bill on the monthly basis. 23. The monthly consolidated bill in triplicate for the vehicle hired will be submitted to the Offi ce of the Drawing & Disbursing Officer, Dindigul, within five days of the end of the month wi th log book. 24. The office of the Drawing & Disbursing Officer, Dindigul will release due amount after maki ng recoveries related to the liabilities/ reimbursement/claim, penalties (as mentioned in Poi nt.26), toll charges and any other entry taxes, if any, through online payment of RTGS/NEFT , in favor of Contractor, Subject to deduction of tax at source. 25.
